note: Bundled seed for offline use; refreshed at each release (VERSIONING.md checklist). When online the app downloads fresher copies of the runtime_fetching files from the data branch about once a week, or on demand from Settings, and keeps a download only if checksums.json carries a valid signature, the file matches its hash, passes validation, and is newer than the copy it already has.

datasets.notes: Bundled seed for offline use; refreshed by scripts/refresh_all.py at release time and by the data branch between releases.

Month-end rates (the last ECB business day of each month; the current month keeps its latest day). Bundled seed for offline use; refreshed by scripts/refresh_all.py at release time and by the data branch between releases.

datasets.source_name: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Fiscal Data)
datasets.notes: Average interest rate on all outstanding marketable debt of each type, monthly: a reference figure for the T-Bill calculator, not what a new security yields (see treasury_auction_yields). Refreshed by scripts/refresh_all.py at release time and by the data branch between releases.

datasets.dataset_name: Treasury 10-Year Note and TIPS Auction Yields
datasets.source_name: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Fiscal Data)
datasets.notes: High (stop-out) yields of completed 10-year Treasury note and 10-year TIPS auctions, new issues and reopenings. The I Bond & TIPS calculator defaults its TIPS real rate and nominal yield to the latest of each. Refreshed by scripts/refresh_all.py at release time and by the data branch between releases.

datasets.source_name: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Fiscal Data)
datasets.notes: One row per six-month issue window (fixed rate, semiannual inflation rate, composite rate). Treasury announces new rates every May 1 and November 1; the scheduled refresh picks them up the same day.
National baseline and contiguous-US ceiling one-unit limits per calendar year, parsed from FHFA's county list. FHFA publishes the next year's list in late November; the daily refresh picks it up.

Reference transcription of the Uniform Lifetime Table. The RMD calculator uses the same factors from a table built into the app, so this file is neither downloaded nor refreshed; check it against Publication 590-B before each release.

datasets.dataset_name: US Income Tax Parameters (federal, FICA, capital gains, retirement plans, states)
datasets.source_name: Internal Revenue Service (Rev. Proc. 2024-40, Rev. Proc. 2025-32, Notice 2025-67), Social Security Administration, state revenue departments
datasets.notes: Generated by scripts/refresh_tax.py from the primary IRS and state revenue-department documents cited in it (run `python3 scripts/refresh_tax.py --check` to confirm the committed file matches); schema_version 4. Published and downloaded with the other datasets; the app ignores a downloaded copy with an older schema (TaxDataBundle.minimumSchemaVersion) or one older than the copy bundled in the app.
